answer_1.quote: We propose a Pretrained Language Model (PLM)-based Generative Post-processing Network (GenPPN) that can postprocess the output of NLGs ...

answer_2.quote: We used common metrics for task-oriented dialogues: Turn, Inform F1/Precision/Recall, Book Rate, Task Success, and DA F1.

answer_4.quote: We tested whether GenPPN optimized by dialogue simulation is also effective for humans. Over 50 crowd workers were recruited via Amazon Mechanical Turk, and each worker interacted once with one of the systems ... each worker was asked to rate the system's ability to understand the language (Und.), the accuracy of the system's responses (App.), and overall satisfaction with the dialogue (Sat.) on a 5-point Likert scale.
answer_4.guideline: Workers rated the system on three criteria: understanding, appropriateness of responses, and overall satisfaction, using a 5-point Likert scale.
